records.jp: あ、見て！
records.en_original: Oh, look!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, look!
records.en: Oh, look!

records.jp: きっとあれが麻央のフラグメントだね
records.en_original: That has to be Mao's Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: That has to be Mao's Fragment.
records.en: That has to be Mao's Fragment.

records.jp: ヒナちゃん、お願い
records.en_original: Take it from here, Hina.
records.en_auxiliary: Take it from here, Hina.
records.en: Take it from here, Hina-chan.

records.jp: わかった
records.en_original: I'm on it.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm on it.
records.en: I'm on it.

records.jp: （こないだは、ただ混乱してるだけで、<CR>ちゃんと麻央の心に向き合えなかった）
records.en_original: (Last time, I was too confused and overwhemed to confront Mao's soul properly.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Last time, I was too confused and overwhemed to confront Mao's feelings properly.)
records.en: (Last time, I was too confused<CR>to properly face Mao's heart.)

records.jp: （今度はどんなものが見えても絶対呑まれない。<CR>最後まで見届けてみせる）
records.en_original: (This time, it doesn't matter what I see in there. I'll maker sure to see this through to the end!)
records.en_auxiliary: (This time, it doesn't matter what I see in there—I'll make sure to see this through to the end!)
records.en: (This time, no matter what I see, I won't let it swallow me.<CR>I'll see it through to the very end.)

records.jp: （裏切り者！）
records.en_original: (Traitor!)
records.en_auxiliary: (Traitor!)
records.en: (Traitor!)

records.jp: （お父さん、お母さん！　なんであの子の秘密、<CR>記者の人に話したの！？　絶対内緒って言ったのに……！）
records.en_original: (Dad! Mom! Why did you tell the reporter about her secret!? I told you not to tell anybody...!)
records.en_auxiliary: (Dad! Mom! Why did you tell the reporter about her secret?! I told you not to tell anybody!)
records.en: (Dad! Mom! Why did you tell the reporter her secret!?<CR>I told you it had to stay between us...!)

records.jp: （これでいいんだよ、麻央。これで今度の主役はお前のものだ）
records.en_original: (It's all going to be okay, Mao. Now the next lead role is yours for sure.)
records.en_auxiliary: (It's all going to be okay, Mao. Now the next lead role will be yours for sure.)
records.en: (This is for the best, Mao. Now the next lead role will be yours.)

records.jp: （よかったわねぇ、麻央。また記者会見用の服を新調しないと。<CR>美容院の予約も入れておかなきゃねぇ）
records.en_original: (Isn't that lovely? Come now, we've got to get your clothes and hair ready for your press interview.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Isn't that lovely? Come now, we've got to get your clothes and hair ready for your press interview.)
records.en: (That's wonderful, Mao. We'll have to buy you a new outfit for the press conference.<CR>And make a hair salon appointment.)

records.jp: （お、お母さん、お父さん……）
records.en_original: (M-Mom, Dad......)
records.en_auxiliary: (M-Mom, Dad...)
records.en: (M-Mom, Dad...)

records.jp: （麻央のこと、信じてたのに。<CR>信じてたからいろいろ相談したのに）
records.en_original: (I trusted you, Mao! I told you all these things because I trusted you!)
records.en_auxiliary: (I trusted you, Mao! I told you all those things because I trusted you!)
records.en: (I trusted you, Mao.<CR>I told you so many things because I trusted you.)

records.jp: （裏切り者……麻央なんて、死んじゃえばいいんだ！）
records.en_original: (You betrayed me... I wish you were dead!)
records.en_auxiliary: (You betrayed me... I wish you were dead!)
records.en: (You betrayed me... I wish you were dead!)

records.jp: 世界は悪意で満ちている
records.en_original: This world is full of malice.
records.en_auxiliary: This world is full of malice.
records.en: This world is full of malice.

records.jp: （なあ麻央、麻央はお父さんとお母さん、どっちについてくる？<CR>もちろんお父さんだよな？）
records.en_original: (Hey, Mao. It's time to decide: who do you want to go with, me or your mom? Of course it's your dear old dad, right?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Hey, Mao. It's time to decide: who do you want to go with, me or your mom? Of course it's your dear old dad, right?)
records.en: (Hey, Mao. Who are you going with, Dad or Mom?<CR>Dad, of course, right?)

records.jp: （何言ってるの、お母さんよねぇ？）
records.en_original: (What are you saying? Of course she'll say Mom.)
records.en_auxiliary: (What are you saying? Of course she'll say Mom.)
records.en: (What are you talking about? You're coming with Mom, right?)

records.jp: （こいつがいれば金に困ることはない……。<CR>絶対俺が手に入れてやる）
records.en_original: (I certainly won't have any financial problems if I get custody... She's mine for sure.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I certainly won't have any financial problems if I get custody... She's mine for sure.)
records.en: (As long as I have her, I'll never have to worry about money...<CR>I'll make sure I get her.)

records.jp: （この子は、麻央は金の卵を産むニワトリ……絶対に渡すものか）
records.en_original: (Mao's my little hen who lays me eggs of gold... I'll never let him have her.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Mao's my little hen who lays me eggs of gold... I'll never let him have her.)
records.en: (This child—Mao—is my hen that lays golden eggs... I'll never hand her over.)

records.jp: （さぁ）
records.en_original: (Now)
records.en: (Well?)

records.jp: （さぁ）
records.en_original: (Now)
records.en: (Well?)

records.jp: （（お父さんとお母さん、どっちについてくる？））
records.en_original: ((Who do you want to live with, Dad or Mom?))
records.en_auxiliary: (Who do you want to live with, Dad or Mom?)
records.en: ((Who are you going with, Dad or Mom?))

records.jp: （いやぁああああ！）
records.en_original: (Noooo!)
records.en_auxiliary: (Noooo!)
records.en: (Noooo!)

records.jp: 人の悪意は決してなくなることはない
records.en_original: There's no way to purge a person of the malice inside them.
records.en_auxiliary: There's no way to purge a person of the malice inside them.
records.en: Human malice will never disappear.

records.jp: （そういえば蜷川さん、最近、主役少ないわよね。<CR>何かあったのかな）
records.en_original: (Ninagawa hasn't gotten many lead roles lately. What do you think happened?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Ninagawa hasn't gotten many lead roles lately. What do you think happened?)
records.en: (Come to think of it, Ninagawa-san hasn't had many lead roles lately.<CR>I wonder if something happened.)

records.jp: （知らないの？　あの子の親、娘を売りこむために、<CR>ヤクザみたいな連中を雇ってたって話）
records.en_original: (You don't know? Rumor has it her parents hired some shady people to make sure she'd get famous.)
records.en_auxiliary: (You don't know? Rumor has it her parents hired some shady people to make sure she'd get famous.)
records.en: (Haven't you heard? Her parents supposedly hired gangsters<CR>to promote their daughter.)

records.jp: （ネットのニュースに出てたけど……本当なんだ？<CR>買収とか恐喝とかもやってたって聞いたけど）
records.en_original: (I saw that online... But is it true? I read they even used blackmail and bribes!)
records.en_auxiliary: (I saw that online... But is it true? I read they even used blackmail and bribes!)
records.en: (I saw it in the online news... Is it really true?<CR>I heard they even used bribery and blackmail.)

records.jp: （マジっぽいよ。警察沙汰になってスポンサーもつかなく<CR>なってるとか。で、とうの両親は離婚して財産分与の裁判中って）
records.en_original: (Yeah, the police started investigating and they lost their sponsors. Then her parents filed for divorce!)
records.en_auxiliary: (Yeah, the police started investigating and they lost their sponsors. Then her parents filed for divorce!)
records.en: (It sounds true. The police got involved, and now no sponsors will touch her.<CR>Her parents divorced and are fighting over the property settlement in court.)

records.jp: （なぁんだ、幻滅。結局お金の力で役を取ってただけなんだ。<CR>芸能人の知り合いができて自慢できるかと思ったけど）
records.en_original: (Wow, that's disappointing. So she just bought her way into fame? I thought I could brag about knowing her.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Wow, that's disappointing. So she just bought her way into fame? I thought I could brag about knowing her.)
records.en: (How disappointing. So she only got those roles through money after all.<CR>I thought I could brag about knowing a celebrity.)

records.jp: （関わらないほうがいいよ）
records.en_original: (No way. You're gonna want to keep your distance from her.)
records.en_auxiliary: (No way. You're gonna want to keep your distance from her.)
records.en: (We'd better not get involved with her.)

records.jp: （ね、関わらないようにしましょう）
records.en_original: (Yeah, that might be a good rule for all of us.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Yeah, that might be a good rule for all of us.)
records.en: (Yeah. Let's stay away from her.)

records.jp: （（違う、私はただ演技が、演じることが好きだっただけで））
records.en_original: ((No, all I did was act! I loved acting!))
records.en_auxiliary: (No, all I did was act! I loved acting!)
records.en: ((No, that's not it. I just loved acting—performing.))

records.jp: （関わらないようにしましょう）
records.en_original: (We should stay away from her.)
records.en_auxiliary: (We should stay away from her.)
records.en: (We should stay away from her.)

records.jp: 悪意こそが人の本質……人間は悪意の中で、<CR>悪意をまき散らすことでしか生きていけない
records.en_original: Humanity is malicious... It's their essence. They can only live by taking their malice out on others.
records.en_auxiliary: Humanity is malicious... It's their essence. They can only live by taking their malice out on others.
records.en: Malice is the true essence of humanity... People can only survive amid malice,<CR>by spreading malice themselves.

records.jp: 善意で接しても裏切られるだけ、居場所が奪われていくだけ
records.en_original: Kindness only leads to betrayal. It's a road to isolation.
records.en_auxiliary: Kindness only leads to betrayal. It's a road to isolation.
records.en: Even if you approach them with goodwill, they'll only betray you and take away the place where you belong.

records.jp: それなら、私は私のやり方で自分の世界を守る。<CR>悪意を全部呑み込む、悪意そのものになってあげる！
records.en_original: Which is why I have to protect myself. I will become malice. Malice strong enough to devour everyone else's!
records.en_auxiliary: Which is why I have to protect myself. I will become malice. Malice strong enough to devour everyone else's!
records.en: Then I'll protect my world in my own way.<CR>I'll swallow up all malice and become malice itself!

records.jp: （だ、だめだ。引き込まれる）
records.en_original: (No, it's pulling me in!)
records.en_auxiliary: (No, it's pulling me in!)
records.en: (No, it's pulling me in!)

records.jp: （悪意に心が塗り潰される）
records.en_original: (Her malice is seeping into my heart!)
records.en_auxiliary: (Her malice is seeping into my heart!)
records.en: (My heart is being painted over by malice.)

records.jp: （真っ黒に）
records.en_original: (It's pitch black...)
records.en_auxiliary: (It's pitch black...)
records.en: (Until it's pitch-black.)

records.jp: （麻央の言うとおりかも）
records.en_original: (Mao might be right.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Mao might be right.)
records.en: (Mao might be right.)

records.jp: （人間なんてみんな、自分だけが大事で<CR>人のことなんかどうでもいいのかも）
records.en_original: (Maybe it's true that people only care about themselves. That they don't care about others at all.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Maybe it's true that people only care about themselves—that they don't care about others at all.)
records.en: (Maybe it's true that people only care about themselves,<CR>and don't care about anyone else at all.)

records.jp: （千紘をいじめてた子たち、麻央に言われるがまま盗みをしてた子、<CR>盗撮をしていた梨佳と香織の先輩）
records.en_original: (The girls who bullied Chihiro, the thief who listened to Mao, the track team member who set up the hidden camera...)
records.en_auxiliary: (The girls who bullied Chihiro, the thief who listened to Mao, the track team member who set up the hidden camera...)
records.en: (The girls who bullied Chihiro, the girl who stole because Mao told her to,<CR>and Rika and Kaori's Senpai who secretly filmed them.)

records.jp: （そうだ……バレエをやってる時もひどいこと言われたっけ）
records.en_original: (...And the people said terrible things to me back when I still danced.)
records.en_auxiliary: (...And the people who said terrible things to me back when I still danced.)
records.en: (...And the people said terrible things to me back when I still danced.)

records.jp: （うまくいっている時はよかったけど……<CR>大事なコンクールで失敗した途端、メチャクチャに叩かれて）
records.en_original: (They seemed nice at first...but as soon as I messed up at an important competition, they turned against me.)
records.en_auxiliary: (They seemed nice at first...but as soon as I messed up at an important competition, they turned against me.)
records.en: (Things were fine when I was doing well...<CR>but the moment I failed at an important competition, they tore me apart.)

records.jp: （昨日まで応援してくれた人たちが、ころっと掌を返してきて）
records.en_original: (One day, they would cheer me on, and the next they'd turn their backs.)
records.en_auxiliary: (One day, they would cheer me on, and the next they'd turn their backs.)
records.en: (People who had supported me until the day before suddenly turned on me.)

records.jp: （……なんだか、意識が遠くなってきた）
records.en_original: (...I'm starting to lose consciousness...)
records.en_auxiliary: (...I'm starting to lose consciousness...)
records.en: (...My consciousness is fading.)

records.jp: （……ごめん、みんな、私）
records.en_original: (Sorry, everyone, I...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Sorry, everyone, I...)
records.en: (Sorry, everyone... I...)

records.jp: すっごくステキだったよ！
records.en_original: You were amazing!
records.en_auxiliary: You were amazing!
records.en: You were amazing!

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: キレイだった。背中に羽が生えてるみたいだった
records.en_original: You were so pretty! It's like you had wings.
records.en_auxiliary: You were so pretty! It's like you had wings.
records.en: You were so pretty! It's like you had wings.

records.jp: なんであんなに高く跳べるの？　誰かに支えてもらってるの？
records.en_original: How can you jump so high? Did you have someone holding you?
records.en_auxiliary: How can you jump so high? Did you have someone holding you?
records.en: How can you jump so high? Did you have someone holding you?

records.jp: え？　で、でも私、今日はジャンプ、失敗しちゃって
records.en_original: Huh? B-But, I messed up that jump today...
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? B-but, I messed up my jump today...
records.en: Huh? B-But, I messed up that jump today...

records.jp: ぜんぜん気にならなかったよ、ね？
records.en_original: That didn't bother us at all, right?
records.en_auxiliary: That didn't bother us at all, right?
records.en: We didn't notice at all, right?

records.jp: うん、ずっと見とれてたから、わからなかった！
records.en_original: Yeah, you were so amazing we didn't even notice!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, you were so amazing, we didn't even notice!
records.en: Yeah, we were too mesmerized to notice!

records.jp: これからもがんばって！
records.en_original: We're rooting for you!
records.en_auxiliary: We're rooting for you!
records.en: We're rooting for you!

records.jp: いっぱいステキな演技を見せてね！
records.en_original: We wanna see more of your beautiful performances!
records.en_auxiliary: We wanna see more of your beautiful performances!
records.en: We wanna see more of your beautiful performances!

records.jp: （そう……だ）
records.en_original: (That's...right.)
records.en_auxiliary: (That's...right.)
records.en: (That's...right.)

records.jp: （人間は悪意だけじゃない。<CR>だって私の中にはこんなに温かな思い出がある）
records.en_original: (There's more to people than malice. I have so many warm feelings inside of me too.)
records.en_auxiliary: (There's more to people than malice. I have so many warm feelings inside of me too.)
records.en: (People aren't made of malice alone.<CR>After all, I have so many warm memories inside me.)

records.jp: （確かに悪意は、誰の中にも存在する。<CR>でも、それを消し去るだけの力が“善意”にはあるんだ）
records.en_original: (Of course, everyone has a little malice inside of them, but kindness has the power to erase that negativity.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Of course, everyone has a little malice inside of them, but kindness has the power to erase that negativity!)
records.en: (Everyone has malice within them.<CR>But goodwill has the power to erase it.)

records.jp: （そのことは、ここでの、星ノ宮での毎日も教えてくれた）
records.en_original: (I'm reminded of that every day here at Hoshinomiya.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I'm reminded of that every day here at Hoshinomiya.)
records.en: (My days here at Hoshinomiya have taught me that too.)

records.jp: （日菜子ちゃんが高校に来てくれた！）
records.en_original: (Hinako finally made it to school!)
records.en_auxiliary: (Hinako finally made it to school!)
records.en: (Hinako-chan came to our high school!)

records.jp: （また一緒の学校に通える！　一緒の時間が過ごせる！）
records.en_original: (We're schoolmates all over again! And we can even hang out together this time!)
records.en_auxiliary: (We're schoolmates all over again! And we can even hang out together this time!)
records.en: (We'll be at the same school again! We can spend time together!)

records.jp: （早苗）
records.en_original: (Sanae.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Sanae.)
records.en: (Sanae.)

records.jp: （昨日の……お礼）
records.en_original: (Thanks....for yesterday.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Thanks...for yesterday.)
records.en: (Thanks...for yesterday.)

records.jp: （み……んなが行くところなら……どこ……でも）
records.en_original: (Anywhere...as long as we're...together.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Anywhere...as long as we're...together.)
records.en: (Anywhere...as long as we're...together.)

records.jp: （千紘）
records.en_original: (Chihiro.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Chihiro.)
records.en: (Chihiro.)

records.jp: （確かに今日、君と過ごした時間はとても興味深いものだった。<CR>そう、今までになく……）
records.en_original: (It was certainly intriguing to spend time with you today. Like nothing I've ever experienced.)
records.en_auxiliary: (The time I spent with you today was fascinating. I can't say I've ever experienced anything like it.)
records.en: (The time I spent with you today was certainly fascinating.<CR>Yes, unlike anything I've experienced before...)

records.jp: （ああ……そうか、これが“楽しい”という感情か）
records.en_original: (Oh... So this is "fun," is it?)
records.en_auxiliary: (This must be "joy.")
records.en: (Ah...so this is what 'fun' feels like.)

records.jp: （有理）
records.en_original: (Yuri.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Yuri.)
records.en: (Yuri.)

records.jp: （人の心は色々……その中には確かに悪意もある。<CR>たくさんのフラグメントに触れて、そのことはよく分かった）
records.en_original: (People hold a lot in their hearts...malice included. I've encountered enough Fragments to know that.)
records.en_auxiliary: (People hold a lot in their hearts...malice included. I've encountered enough Fragments to know that.)
records.en: (People hold many things in their hearts, and malice is certainly one of them.<CR>Touching so many Fragments has made that clear to me.)

records.jp: （だけど、だからこそ悪意だけじゃなくて<CR>光があることも分かる）
records.en_original: (But that's also taught me that people have light in their hearts as well.)
records.en_auxiliary: (But that's also taught me that people have light in their hearts as well.)
records.en: (But that's exactly why I also know<CR>there is light, not only malice.)

records.jp: （温かい、みんなの想いがあるって分かるんだ）
records.en_original: (Everyone is capable of warmth.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Everyone is capable of warmth.)
records.en: (I know everyone has warm feelings in their hearts.)

records.jp: 麻央……、私はあなたの悪意を『認めない』！
records.en_original: Mao... I refuse to accept your malice!
records.en_auxiliary: Mao... I refuse to accept your malice!
records.en: Mao... I refuse to accept your malice!
